description: The bar chart illustrates a comparative breakdown of three components—“Context,” “Generated Response,” and “Other”—across two methods: “Ours” and “Standard,” as evaluated in the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” The horizontal axis represents the percentage contribution of each component, while the vertical axis lists the two methods. For the “Ours” method, the stacked bar shows 60.6% attributed to “Context” (blue), 31.7% to “Generated Response” (orange), and 7.7% to “Other” (green). In contrast, the “Standard” method’s bar is composed of 23.6% “Context,” 51.1% “Generated Response,” and 25.3% “Other.” The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding for each component. The chart visually emphasizes that the “Ours” method allocates a significantly larger proportion to “Context” and a smaller proportion to “Other” compared to the “Standard” method, while the “Generated Response” component is more dominant in the “Standard” approach. The bars are not sorted by value but are grouped by method, with each method’s composition shown as a single stacked horizontal bar.
